event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Semis ripped, breadth confirmed, dollar bid.
Nov 10 CPI printed 0.4% m/m vs 0.30% fc and core 0.3% vs 0.20%, yet XLK +3.23% and SOXX +6.01% led anyway — the market bought the AI complex rather than the rate path. With 66% advancers, 44 new highs vs 1 low, and RSP +0.80%, this was a real risk-on bid, not a mega-cap squeeze.

INDICES — VIX 17.5, below its 20-day 19.3, fear draining.
SOXX +6.01%, QQQ +2.31%, SPY +1.32%, IWM +0.89%, DIA +0.52%. Large beat small by 1.42pp. Most notable cross-asset: dollar UUP +0.69% while gold GLD -1.13% and VIX futures VIXY -6.77%. SPY and QQQ sit above their 200-day MAs — no CTA sell trigger.

VOLUME & BREADTH — SOXX 2.5x and KWEB 2.2x are the attention magnets; IJR 0.5x and RSP 0.6x are being ignored. SPY 0.8x and QQQ 0.8x are below average — the rally is real but not volume-confirmed at index level. SOXX vol +6.01% is accumulation; KWEB vol -1.62% is distribution. Breadth confirms: 72% above the 50-DMA, 63% above the 200-DMA, adv/dec 332/167, up/down vol 3.17.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLK Technology +3.23%, XLE Energy +1.86%, XLI Industrials +1.33%, XLC Comms +0.78%, XLF Financials +0.58%, XLP Staples +0.46%, XLB Materials +0.32%, XLU Utilities +0.21%, XLV Healthcare +0.04%, XLRE Real Estate +0.02%, XLY Discretionary -0.05%. Top industries DRAM +10.36% and WGMI +8.76%; bottom KWEB -1.62% and UNG -1.92%. Flows: XLK +$1,256mm (100p) and XLV +$513mm (90p) in, versus XLF -$1,382mm (2p) and XLC -$900mm (2p) out — tech inflows confirm the price leadership. Money going into AI hardware and healthcare defensives, out of financials. Rotstate: AI hardware leading.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 1.16 signals protection demand, QQQ 0.84 neutral, skew +5.9% and +10.3% both put-tilted; SPY spot sits near its 762 gamma flip and QQQ near 697. VIX 17.5 under its 19.3 20-day MA is complacent, while VIXEQ 42.0 versus VIX 17.5 is an extremely wide gap — low implied correlation, a rotation/stock-picker tape. MOVE is unpopulated, no bond vol read.

CROSS-ASSET — Dollar +0.69% is pressuring gold -1.13% and silver's +0.37% looks like the laggard holdout; the API crude build of 896.8 vs -32.7 fc explains oil flat at +0.01% and energy still bid on equity flows. Next FOMC is Dec 9; Polymarket prices 11% for a 50bp+ hike and 3% for no change (down 18pp in 5 days).

SIGNALS & WATCH — Greed at 62.4. Movers: MU +11.89% as its one-month slide reversed, MRVL +9.33% and ORCL +8.82% on sector-wide strength. 20-day extremes: XLV +8.62% best, XLK -8.44% worst; XLK -1.21% 5d still leads 20d laggards. Watch KWEB -1.62% on 2.2x volume, GLD -1.13% near gamma flip 374 versus max pain 365, and IWM +0.89% with PCR at 0.27 — the most complacent options book on the board.
